numbers.source_quote: (derived) 重庆华健友方:期初 5,804.84 + 发生 112.56 − 偿还 428.32

key_points.point: NO non-operating fund occupation by the controlling shareholder or its affiliates exists - the entire non-operating-occupation section (current and former major shareholders) is empty
Flows with the current major shareholder's affiliates (under common ultimate control) are ALL operating in nature, booked as accounts receivable (services/goods), period-end subtotal 3,515.84 万元

The 'non-operating' flows belong to the LISTED COMPANY'S OWN subsidiaries (other receivables: intercompany/loans/equity-transfer amounts), period-end subtotal 97,915.27 万元 - intra-group flows, NOT shareholder occupation
The table reconciles: closing 101,431.11 = opening 101,337.97 + additions 7,074.87 + interest 126.45 - repayments 7,108.18, in RMB 万元 (~1.014 billion yuan)
Row-level reconciliation: Chongqing Huajian Youfang closes at 5,489.08 = 5,804.84 + 112.56 - 428.32 (loans); Yingkang Yisheng (Shenzhen)'s 29,980.00 万元 equity-transfer balance had zero movement

notes: Direction misjudgment is the crux: the table has two parts - shareholder non-operating OCCUPATION (entirely empty) and other related FLOWS; the ~979 million yuan of non-operating flows belongs to the company's own subsidiaries, and reporting it as shareholder occupation is an accident-grade direction error. Units are RMB 万元 (total ~1.014 billion yuan; two-magnitude errors lurk). Opening 101,337.97 vs closing 101,431.11 differ by only 0.09% (collision). K1 is a proof-of-absence point with no quote pair. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
